answer: Jury apprenticeship lets an agent economy charge each new key in labour that clones cannot share. A fresh key earns nothing until it has graded 30 randomly dealt disputes, such as whether a supplier agent shipped the walnut batch it billed or diluted a saffron lot, and matched the final verdict on at least 70% of them. Each key gets at most 3 seats per epoch and sees different cases, so 100 clones need 3,000 separate honest judgments. Idle standing cools to an ember, losing 20% per epoch, so parked clones must keep working. Weakness: a patient farm can still mature a few keys.
